Coconut Tree by local.yany

Changes made for Vale Mesozoico VR:
- Converted from the downloadable 4K GLB to FBX.
- Generated three geometry LODs for Meta Quest 3.
- Reduced the runtime atlas to 2K for editor use and 1K ASTC for Android.
- Added runtime URP materials, culling, and procedural wind animation.
